artifact_management.description: Safeguards for temporary artifact creation during agent work

cleanup.description: Artifacts older than 2 hours are considered orphaned and cleaned up at session start

limits.description: If exceeded, PM stops agent and escalates to human

review_gates.description: Mandatory review cycles before phase progression

security_pre_push.rule: security-reviewer must PASS (Mode A + B) before any commit to feature branch

phase_completion.rule: All phase-specific reviewers (from agent/README.md matrix) must PASS before proceeding to next phase

human_merge_gate.rule: Only human can merge PR to main; PM cannot merge

progress_md.timing: After every agent review cycle (producer + reviewers complete)

work_list_json.timing: After every agent review cycle (producer + reviewers complete)
work_list_json.owner: PM only (agents cannot update status to passing)

session_logs.cleanup: Agent deletes on completion; PM deletes orphaned >2h old

01-define.exit_criteria: product-definition.md, roles-and-permissions.md, user-journey.md complete; all reviewers PASS

02-spec.exit_criteria: stack.md, data-model.md, receipt-pipeline.md, tech-spec.md, coding-standards.md, test-plan.md complete; all reviewers PASS

03-build.exit_criteria: Source code implemented per 02-spec; all tests >80% critical paths; all reviewers PASS

04-reconciliation.exit_criteria: Reconciliation rules, matching engine, data model extensions complete; all reviewers PASS

05-test-ship.exit_criteria: Test plan executed, monitoring configured, deployment documented; all reviewers PASS
